title: Offline EDSGN required experiment matrix extraction

source_docs.sections: Scope and invariants; Scientific acceptance; Resource/search; Delivery

scope.included: Offline implementation and evidence, M0-M6; retain negative/null outcomes.

mandatory_matrix.comparison_or_run: Run the frozen model/baselines on email-Eu-core-temporal and MOOC activity as separate tasks; email predicts member incoming/outgoing counts; MOOC predicts course/target activity counts (not dropout).

minimum_coverage.real_split: chronological 70/10/20; exact boundaries recorded; all targets stay within split; val/test may use only past history

mandatory_matrix.measurement: Per-required-horizon, per-feature raw-unit MAE/RMSE; report node-activity strata. Inputs use train-only log1p normalization; prediction heads return nonnegative raw counts. Preserve input missingness/true-zero distinction.
leakage_and_provenance: record official source page, download time, bytes, SHA256, format
half-open bins; exclude possibly incomplete final bin
preserve email duplicate triples; audit same ACTIONID duplicates in MOOC
do not load dropout labels or derive calendar features from relative time
do not claim released events represent all real-world behavior
train-only nodes and statistics; record excluded nodes/events

mandatory_matrix.comparison_or_run: Core controlled simulation plus a separate N=256 scale check; do not expose oracle matrices, switches, or clean masked inputs to model/scheduler.

minimum_coverage.generator: x[t]=W[t]x[t-1]+epsilon[t]; P nonnegative, zero diagonal, row-stochastic, <=8 non-self neighbors/row; W=.2I+.6P, row sum/infinity norm <=.8

mandatory_matrix.interpretation_limit: Structural recovery is a constrained simulation diagnostic, not evidence of real causal edges.

mandatory_matrix.comparison_or_run: Run persistence, linear, compact GRU, then V0/V1; add an official DGCRN adaptation as an external strong baseline.

tasks: MOOC as applicable to frozen protocol
minimum_coverage.training_protocol: same target/history/objective and an explicitly comparable parameter/search budget; record each baseline's source/commit, adaptation differences, and hyperparameter budget
minimum_coverage.formal_seeds: five-seed coverage for formal core comparisons; the docs do not state an independent seed minimum for every external baseline

mandatory_matrix.comparison_or_run: Execute all V0-V9, retaining ANN controls and SNN method.

variants.V0: static graph; confidence off; ANN; relation-memory off; full updates
variants.V1: dynamic graph; confidence on; ANN; relation-memory off; full updates
variants.V2: dynamic; confidence on; ANN; relation-memory on; full updates
variants.V3: dynamic; confidence on; SNN; relation-memory off; full updates
variants.V4: dynamic; confidence on; SNN; relation-memory on; full updates
variants.V5: V4 scheduler with periodic updates; same frozen V4 checkpoint
variants.V6: V4 scheduler with random updates; same frozen V4 checkpoint
variants.V7: V4 scheduler with adaptive updates; same frozen V4 checkpoint
variants.V8: V2/ANN adaptive updates; same frozen V2 checkpoint
variants.V9: dynamic; confidence off; SNN; relation-memory on; full updates

minimum_coverage.policy_checkpoint_sharing: V5/V6/V7 share frozen V4 checkpoint; V8 uses frozen V2 checkpoint

mandatory_matrix.comparison_or_run: V4 vs V9; static/dynamic reference V0 vs V1; dynamic fixed-periodic refresh reference. Include synthetic known-change and noise-only scenarios.
mandatory_matrix.minimum_coverage: Use formal five-seed core comparison; report raw-unit horizon metrics, graph change intensity, response/recovery, update/age and measured cost.
mandatory_matrix.decision: Apply the frozen H1 rule; null/negative is reportable, not a failure of evidence completion.

mandatory_matrix.comparison_or_run: V3 vs V4 and V1 vs V2; add shuffled-c, constant-g, and unconditional-neighbor-reset controls. Keep graph, refresh counts and effect times matched when changing memory signal.
mandatory_matrix.minimum_coverage: Formal five-seed comparison; matched total width; include c/g semantics and fast/slow rates/ages; report raw-unit accuracy and cost.
mandatory_matrix.decision: Apply frozen H2 rule; c must provide evidence beyond shuffled c to accept the relation-specific claim.

mandatory_matrix.area: H3 selective scheduling and actual acceleration
mandatory_matrix.comparison_or_run: V7 vs V4/V5/V6 at validation-calibrated measured costs; V7 vs V8 for the independent SNN value. Execute each selective policy as a real sequential replay; do not infer skipped-update predictions from full-track priority simulation.

minimum_coverage.policy_calibration: validation only; frozen parameters and rules before test

mandatory_matrix.interpretation: Operation-count reduction is not speedup. Include all causal prior/candidate/encoding/cache costs; report preprocessing separately. Report the error-vs-measured-runtime curve, including no-advantage results.

mandatory_matrix.comparison_or_run: After clean N64 semantic smoke, run declared synthetic missingness and generator stress cases; do not start with the full Cartesian product.
For formal core comparisons, report five-seed uncertainty and explicit frozen decision for each H1/H2/H3; retain per-horizon and feature metrics and negative findings.

minimum_coverage.selection: mean validation MAE at required horizons; test is not used to select configurations
minimum_coverage.test: single frozen final evaluation; no post-test tuning

mandatory_matrix.comparison_or_run: Each formal run must be reconstructible from data provenance, resolved config, environment, exact commands, checkpoint, logs, predictions, metrics, profile and trace.
mandatory_matrix.test_freeze: hash model parameters before and after final test; runtime cache excluded from weight hash; trace c=null except actual graph refresh

mandatory_matrix.comparison_or_run: All 26 tests in implementation-plan §12.1 must pass; reference_semantics coverage alone is explicitly insufficient.
minimum_coverage: T01 past prediction invariant to future input
T02 reject target out-of-bounds
T03 distinguish true zero and missing
T04 temporal candidate/node leakage
T05 sparse support/candidate cap/direction
T06 ID-aligned c invariant to row order
T07 disjoint support c=1
T08 first graph/no-neighbor finite
T09 g=1 or beta near zero
T10 local memory unaffected by g
T11 accumulate and consume deferred g once
T12 delayed reset consumed once over skips
T13 positive ordered taus/multistep consistency
T14 indexed all-open equals full reference
T15 all-off skips expensive modules but reads out
T16 graph-on/state-off
T17 graph-off/state-on
T18 constant high level retained by mixed encoder
T19 frozen weight hash
T20 no new adjacency before monitor
T21 mandatory action/max-age/budget overrun
T22 empty active set does not call expensive module and calls scale with activity
T23 reset state between disjoint windows
T24 all policies share windows/perturbations/targets/readout
T25 finite gradients to selected edge score/tau/beta/encoder
T26 fixed tiny-sample full-update overfit reduces loss without divergence

execution_constraints.training: AdamW; lr 0.001 or 0.0003; clip norm 1; weight decay 1e-4; max 100 epochs; patience 10; float32; first update full; max 12 preregistered pilot configs per new module.
execution_constraints.resource: Local Conda only; initial smoke tranche <=2 hours; campaign ceiling 72 aggregate training/profile hours; no changes to other running jobs; record resource feasibility and unfinished rows.
execution_constraints.timing: CPU and GPU separately where available; eager float32 B1 correctness; 10 consecutive warmup windows; at least five repeated full replays with device synchronization as applicable; same replay and random-policy seeds; report median/tail/total. Profile diagnostics must not be stitched into E2E timing.
execution_constraints.test: Freeze preprocessing, nodes, checkpoint, policy, threshold, budget and evaluation slice before one final ordered test replay; no target input to scheduler; no selection/tuning from test.

suggested_or_nonblocking.item: Five suggested figure types: prediction curves, post-change recovery, graph/state refresh timeline, c vs retention, MAE vs measured runtime.

Activity-similarity candidate source is permitted by RP but deferred; first version uses history contacts plus bounded exploration. A later similarity study must use a declared training-calibrated prefix or causal rolling summary, never a full-data correlation matrix.
suggested_or_nonblocking.status: follow-up option; not part of first-version required candidate implementation

suggested_or_nonblocking.item: No website; custom graph kernels/extensions only after profiling identifies a bottleneck.

existing_artifacts_and_evidence_scope.artifact_group: data/processed main email/MOOC/synthetic and synthetic stress/episode bundles; prepare scripts/manifests/QC
existing_artifacts_and_evidence_scope.matrix_credit: satisfies data-generation/preprocessing readiness only; not model training, baseline, hypothesis, stress evaluation, or five-seed experiment rows
does not complete formal five-seed model comparisons, external baseline, frozen test, or efficiency matrix

seed0/validation evidence only; not formal five-seed core; not final test; existing legacy runs lack at-launch source binding and therefore cannot pass strict formal provenance gate without explicitly eligible replacement runs

existing_artifacts_and_evidence_scope.artifact_group: edsgn/src interfaces, robustness/statistics/profile modules and their unit/integration logs
existing_artifacts_and_evidence_scope.matrix_credit: does not establish measured H1/H2/H3, five-seed statistics, or full CPU/GPU replay timing
not formal repeated full-replay CPU+GPU E2E profiles and not model-quality experiments

ambiguities_for_root.issue: protocols/experiment-design-v1.md is absent. Although execution contract requires a frozen decision rule for each hypothesis, requested canonical sources do not fully specify the statistical estimator/CI, contrast family, multiplicity correction, or exact numerical accept/reject boundary.
ambiguities_for_root.action: Root should choose/point to the already accepted statistical/claim protocol; do not invent a result threshold. Preserve five-seed uncertainty and report nulls.

ambiguities_for_root.issue: The canonical docs require synthetic missing rates 0/10/30/50 and list multiple generator stresses, while also forbidding an initial full Cartesian product. They do not fully enumerate the later stress cross-product (which rates must pair with which generator/missingness mechanism).
ambiguities_for_root.action: Use the frozen robustness recipes/accepted preparation evidence to select exact required rows; do not infer that prepared scenarios have been evaluated.

ambiguities_for_root.issue: Formal core comparisons explicitly require five seeds, but the number of seeds for every external baseline, N=256 scale check, and each stress cell is not independently specified; synthetic trajectory seed sets are distinct from model-initialization seeds.
ambiguities_for_root.action: Root should define matched external-baseline and stress repetitions in a frozen matrix; do not count trajectory seeds as model seeds.

ambiguities_for_root.issue: The plan says final test is frozen and single-use, but the exact unit of the five-seed test evaluation (one frozen test replay per seed versus other aggregation) and the permitted number of selected checkpoints/policies should be stated in the formal matrix before test access.
ambiguities_for_root.action: Freeze checkpoint/policy set and evaluation protocol before any test evaluation; no test-driven selection.

non_claims: No test-set metrics were opened or computed for this extraction.
No code, training, or tests were run.
Prepared data, implemented APIs, test suites, validation seed0 runs, and resource probes are not interchangeable evidence and do not imply completion of a matrix row.
H1/H2/H3 may be null or negative; no minimum percent gain/speedup is imposed by the source plan.
